scripts.dev: bun run --cwd packages/contracts build && concurrently -n contracts,backend,webapp -c yellow,cyan,green "bun run --cwd packages/contracts dev" "bun run --cwd backend dev" "bun run --cwd webapp dev"
scripts.test:integration: bun run --cwd packages/contracts build && bun run backend/scripts/run-integration-tests.ts
scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/contracts build && bun run --cwd backend build && bun run --cwd webapp build
scripts.quality:lint: eslint backend/src backend/tests backend/scripts webapp/src webapp/tests webapp/scripts webapp/vite.config.ts webapp/functions/api/proxy.test.ts packages/contracts/src packages/contracts/tests e2e scripts/quality --max-warnings 0
scripts.quality:check: bun run --cwd packages/contracts build && bun run quality:lint && bun run quality:probes && bun run db:migrations:check && bun run typecheck && bun test backend/tests packages/contracts/tests webapp/tests webapp/functions/api/proxy.test.ts && bun run security:deps && bun run security:secrets && bun run test:integration && bun run build && bun run bundle:check
scripts.release:verify: bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run types:worker:check && bun run quality:check && bun run test:e2e
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/contracts build && bun run --cwd backend typecheck && bun run --cwd webapp typecheck
